text:
alex: FYI noticed a sharp drop in available GPUs in eu-west3 around 02:03 UTC — provisioner reports available capacity down from ~72% to single digits in ~7m, control-plane rollouts are stuck and tenant console auths are erroring. routing looks noisy.

maria: confirmed. provisioner queue backlog, lots of pod terminations. logs show eviction spikes, snippet: 
```
provisioner: allocate failed: no candidate node found
kubelet: eviction threshold reached: pods terminated\```

zain: any infra network issues? I saw BGP churn on the fabric at ~01:59 UTC that correlates.

alex: yep BGP churn + our routing agent retried. nodes appeared to ghost; autoscaler overreacted and controlplane couldn't reconcile fast enough.

ops-bot: incident created #INC-2026-4886 — P0: eu-west3 GPU starvation + control-plane rollout delay

julie: paging infra oncall @oncall-infra and SRE for a traffic-shift plan.

oncall-infra: investigating. immediate mitigations: pause non-critical rollouts, stop new best-effort provisioner jobs, and drain a subset of pools to standby.

maria: can we fail over tenant auth routing to eu-central1? will add latency but should restore auth path.

zain: feasible but watch out for KV/session cache misses — risk of cache-thundering if we shift too quickly.

alex: propose staged siphon: 10% -> 30% -> 60% with 5m holds. start with a 5-tenant canary.

julie: adding traffic-shift steps to the incident doc and noting cost impact (cross-region egress + extra token ops).

oncall-infra: paused rollouts and scaled down best-effort jobs. beginning 10% auth sink to eu-central1 now.

maria: can we enable prefix KV caching at auth proxies for the shift? TTL short but reduces hits to central KV.

zain: enabled prefix cache TTL=60s and prewarmed keys for high-QPS tenants.

alex: first 5-tenant canary looks good — auth success rates recovered, latency median +~120ms.

ops-bot: routing update: eu-west3->eu-central1 auth siphon 10% at 2193456844

julie: will move to 30% in 3m if no regressions. also calling out a follow-up: autoscaler hysteresis and failover playbook.

oncall-infra: still seeing provisioner controllers in allocation loops; investigating leader-election jitter across controlplane replicas.

maria: if leader-election jitter, adjust lease durations before resuming rollouts.

zain: temporarily increasing leaseTTL 6s->12s to reduce flapping. watching metrics.

alex: keep rollouts paused until we have 10m steady state after lease change, then resume with reduced parallelism.

julie: follow-ups added: autoscaler hysteresis, improved node health signaling, and documented cross-region auth siphon runbook. assigned to infra.

oncall-infra: provisioning metrics recovering, available GPUs climbing 3%->18% as nodes rejoin. starting gradual ramp-down of siphon.

alex: good — plan: 10% -> 5% -> 0% over next 10m. monitor console auth error rates and egress cost counters.

maria: postmortem owner: julie. will capture timeline, root cause = BGP fabric churn + autoscaler/lease interplay, and corrective actions.

ops-bot: incident closed by julie at 2193457020 — service restored, follow-ups created. :white_check_mark:
